privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.paragraph1: DocMo stores only the information required to provide healthcare booking, records, prescriptions, and lab workflows.
privacy.paragraph2: Patient, doctor, and lab data is protected by Supabase row-level security policies and only accessible according to role.
privacy.paragraph3: For support with data handling or access requests, use the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.paragraph1: DocMo is a healthcare workflow demo platform. Appointments, medical documents, and lab reports are managed for authenticated users only.
terms.paragraph2: Users must provide accurate information and use the service only for lawful healthcare-related activities.
terms.paragraph3: For assistance, contact support through the Contact page.

locations.emergencyText: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 immediately or visit your nearest emergency room. Our Downtown Medical Center has 24/7 emergency services.
